title: url-shortener.request-telemetry.v1 event body
description: The open parts of the envelope for this topic: metrics and payload. Derived from the producer as it actually emits, not from intent. Generic per-request HTTP telemetry - deliberately says nothing about what any route of the producing service does.

is_404.description: Pre-computed by the producer rather than derived by each consumer, so every consumer counts the same thing.

code.description: Null is correct and common: a request that never resolved to a short code has none.
